title: Left-branch action embedding
statement: Let $N_0$ and $N_1$ be finite nondeterministic machines over the Boolean alphabet, and let $a$ be an action of $N_0$. The corresponding action on the combined $k_0+k_1$ work tapes keeps $a$'s input movement and output, uses $a$'s work-tape actions on the first $k_0$ tapes and leaves the remaining $k_1$ tapes unwritten and stationary. A successor state of $a$ is sent to the left component of the disjoint union of the two state sets, with the result wrapped as a nonhalting state; if $a$ has no successor state, the combined action also halts.
hypotheses_covered: Two finite nondeterministic machines over the Boolean alphabet
An action of the first machine
